_about: Series = YouTube playlists. Every episode goes in the umbrella playlist plus the one series it names in its 'series' field. youtube_upload.py finds each playlist by its exact title on the channel, or creates it, then adds the video. playlist_id can be filled in by hand to skip the lookup.

umbrella.title: Greek Myths for Sleep
umbrella.description: Every Fernwick Nights story: one Greek myth a night, told slowly and calmly for falling asleep.

Myths of the Sea.description: Sleep stories of sea nymphs, islands, sailors, kingfishers and calm water.

Myths of the Night Sky.description: Sleep stories of the stars, the moon and the constellations, and how they got there.

Myths of Sleep and Dreams.description: Sleep stories of Hypnos, Nyx, the dream-bringers and the river of forgetting, told gently.

Myths of Love and Loyalty.description: Sleep stories of couples, friends and families who stayed true.

Myths of Changing Shape.description: Sleep stories of people who became flowers, trees, birds and springs.

Myths of Clever Mortals.description: Sleep stories of ordinary people who outwitted, outworked or out-waited the gods.

Myths of Gifts and Wonders.description: Sleep stories of strange gifts, enchanted objects and the places they came from.
